dropzone_label: Drop images here or choose from a folder
dropzone_limits: JPEG, PNG, or TIFF · {megabytes} MiB · {megapixels} MP
error_not_found: This record no longer exists. Refresh the page and try again.
error_conflict: The current state does not allow this action. Refresh the page and try again.
error_invalid_request: The submitted data was rejected. Check it and try again.
error_training_conflict: Training cannot start or change in the current state. Check the reviewed images and active runs.
error_training_artifact: The training artifact does not match the run requirements.
error_dataset_model: The images and dataset must use the same model.
error_image_already_used: An image is already matched in this experiment.
error_experiment_has_records: This experiment has records that prevent this change.
error_user_rejected: This change would affect your own access or leave no usable administrator.
error_model_in_use: Only a model nothing records against can be deleted.
ai_explanation: Annotate the image or improve the current draft. AI results remain proposals until you save the review.
ai_no_worker: No AI annotation worker is online. Configure a Worker with Pi and a vision model.
ai_apply_explanation: Replaces the current draft; Undo restores it. To improve this result, start another run from the current draft.
